key_findings.finding: 27 hotels have both Google Travel review data and at least one visible Sikayetvar complaint.
key_findings.limitation: Google and Sikayetvar are different populations with different exposure; this is a coverage fact, not a sentiment comparison.

key_findings.finding: 15 hotels have enough sample size on both sides (Google n>=10, Sikayetvar complaint_n>=5) for a genuinely supported comparison.
key_findings.limitation: Comparisons outside this supported set should be read as directional only.

key_findings.finding: MANAGEMENT_COMMUNICATION shows up as a concern in BOTH Google Travel (low-rating context) and Sikayetvar (recurrent complaint theme) for this hotel.
key_findings.limitation: Two independently-biased corpora agreeing increases confidence, but neither is a random sample.

key_findings.finding: STAFF_SERVICE is a Google Travel strength signal (high-rating context) yet still appears as a Sikayetvar complaint theme for this hotel - a genuine source divergence, not a contradiction.
key_findings.limitation: Complaint corpora over-represent unhappy guests by design; this does not mean the Google signal is wrong.
